title: Each element at 2am
caption:
The house is asleep. Your element is not.

Air is on a call with a friend in another time zone. Fire is restructuring their entire life by Monday. Earth is replaying a conversation from 2017. Water has been asleep since 10:30 and has never seen 2am on purpose.

Tradition pictures Earth and Fire minds running late, and many people find a simple wind-down routine helps.

Send this to whoever's awake right now.
